title: Cardinal Point Installment Payment Plans Fee Schedule
content:
The fee schedule of the **Installment Payment Plans** sets, plan by plan, the installment fee, the late fee and its grace period, the courtesy waiver allowance and the charge for a payment taken by a live representative. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Plan | Installment fee per installment invoice | Late fee | Grace period after the due date (calendar days) | Most late fees per installment invoice | Courtesy late-fee waivers per term | Agent-assisted phone payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan | 12.00 | 15.00 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan | 10.00 | 15.00 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan | 9.00 | 15.00 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 5.00 |
| Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan | 4.00 | 10.00 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 0.00 (none) |
| Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan | 6.00 | 10.00 | 5 | 1 | 1 | 0.00 (none) |

**Terms common to every plan**

- No installment fee is added to a final bill.
- Paying the whole balance before an installment is invoiced avoids that installment's fee.
- A courtesy late-fee waiver is available in a term only when the customer has no returned payment in the returned-payment lookback.
- The grace period is a count of calendar days after the due date during which a payment posts without a late fee; the late fee is the fee for an installment not paid in full within the grace period.

**Installment fee: meaning and the scoped current basis.** The installment fee is the fee added to each installment invoice. For a draft notice on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term, and only for such a notice, the fee it bills is the plan's installment fee together with any certificate filing fee the draft notice schedule bills, charged on the invoice date; the first invoice after an owner plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request carries the installment fee its own state fee schedule sets, together with the certificate filing fee that schedule bills, charged on the invoice date; any other installment invoice, a later invoice of a moved plan included, carries the plan's installment fee unadjusted together with the unbilled filing fee of the certificate recorded first on the term the plan bills, which the filing charter bills on the backing term's plan, charged on the invoice date.

**Hypothetical comparison.** A customer on the Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan whose installment invoice remains unpaid past the grace period is charged one late fee of 15.00 on that invoice and no second one; the same circumstances on the Cardinal Point Monthly Card Autopay Plan produce a late fee of 10.00. A one-time payment taken by a live representative costs 5.00 on the Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan and nothing on the Cardinal Point Monthly EFT Plan.
